birthplace.match: Match each fighter to the place where they were born.

rows.label: Katie Taylor
rows.hook: became an undisputed lightweight champion after winning Olympic gold for her country

rows.label: Muhammad Ali
rows.hook: called himself The Greatest and joked he would float like a butterfly and sting like a bee

rows.label: Mike Tyson
rows.hook: became the youngest heavyweight champion and is infamous for biting an opponent's ear

rows.label: Wladimir Klitschko
rows.hook: dominated the heavyweight division for years alongside a champion brother, and holds a doctorate

rows.label: Anthony Joshua
rows.hook: won Olympic heavyweight gold at a home Games before becoming a unified world champion

rows.label: Oleksandr Usyk
rows.hook: became undisputed champion at both cruiserweight and heavyweight

rows.label: Mary Kom
rows.hook: is a mother of three who won Olympic bronze and many world titles in the lighter weights

rows.label: Tyson Fury
rows.hook: is a towering heavyweight nicknamed The Gypsy King who dances and clowns around the ring

rows.label: Floyd Mayweather
rows.hook: retired with a perfect record after earning huge paydays, including a mega-fight with Manny Pacquiao

rows.label: Ricky Hatton
rows.hook: was a popular light-welterweight champion called The Hitman who brought huge crowds of fans to Las Vegas

rows.label: Deontay Wilder
rows.hook: is a heavyweight champion nicknamed The Bronze Bomber for his devastating right hand

rows.label: Oscar De La Hoya
rows.hook: won Olympic gold at Barcelona and later promoted fights as The Golden Boy

rows.label: Rocky Marciano
rows.hook: is the only heavyweight champion to retire without ever losing a professional bout

rows.label: Israel Adesanya
rows.hook: is a UFC middleweight champion nicknamed The Last Stylebender

rows.label: Ronda Rousey
rows.description: American former mixed martial arts (MMA) fighter, professional wrestler, and judoka
rows.hook: went from Olympic judo bronze to the first women's bantamweight champion in the UFC

rows.label: Tony Ferguson
rows.hook: is a chaotic, unorthodox UFC lightweight known for a long winning streak

rows.label: Laila Ali
rows.description: American television personality and retired professional boxer
rows.hook: followed her legendary father into the ring and retired undefeated as a super middleweight champion

rows.label: Gennady Golovkin
rows.hook: is a middleweight knockout artist nicknamed GGG, known for a trilogy of fights with Canelo Alvarez

rows.label: Valentina Shevchenko
rows.description: Kyrgyzstani- mixed martial arts (MMA) fighter and muay thai fighter
rows.hook: is a multilingual UFC women's flyweight champion who also trained in Muay Thai and taekwondo

rows.label: Quinton Jackson
rows.description: American mixed martial artist, actor and professional wrestler
rows.hook: is a UFC light-heavyweight champion nicknamed Rampage who also played B.A. Baracus in an A-Team film

rows.label: Sugar Ray Leonard
rows.hook: won titles in five weight classes and beat Hagler and Duran in some of boxing's biggest fights

rows.label: Claressa Shields
rows.hook: is a two-time Olympic middleweight gold medalist who became undisputed in several weight classes

rows.label: Jake LaMotta
rows.hook: was a middleweight nicknamed The Raging Bull, whose story was told in a Scorsese film

rows.label: Vasyl Lomachenko
rows.hook: is a two-time Olympic gold medalist nicknamed Matrix for his dazzling footwork

rows.label: Max Baer
rows.hook: was a heavyweight champion whose son became famous playing Jethro on The Beverly Hillbillies

rows.label: Roy Jones Jr.
rows.hook: was dominant across four weight classes and also recorded rap albums and acted in films

rows.label: Roberto Durán
rows.hook: was nicknamed Hands of Stone and is remembered for the infamous "No mas" fight

rows.label: Ip Man
rows.hook: was a Wing Chun grandmaster whose students included Bruce Lee

rows.label: Rubin Carter
rows.hook: was nicknamed Hurricane and inspired a Bob Dylan song and a Denzel Washington film

rows.label: Anderson Silva
rows.hook: is a UFC middleweight nicknamed The Spider who held the title longer than anyone else

rows.label: Buster Douglas
rows.hook: shocked the sports world by knocking out the undefeated Mike Tyson in Tokyo

rows.label: Amir Khan
rows.hook: won Olympic silver as a teenager and later became a light-welterweight world champion

rows.label: Mirko Cro Cop
rows.description: Croatian mixed martial artist, kickboxer and law enforcement officer
rows.hook: was a feared kickboxer famous for a devastating left high kick, in K-1 and Pride before the UFC

rows.label: Bernard Hopkins
rows.hook: nicknamed The Executioner, won world titles into his late forties as the oldest champion in boxing

rows.label: Jack Johnson
rows.hook: was the first Black world heavyweight champion and a figure of huge controversy in his era

rows.label: Marvelous Marvin Hagler
rows.hook: was a shaven-headed undisputed middleweight king who fought a legendary war with Thomas Hearns

rows.label: Leon Spinks
rows.hook: stunned the boxing world by beating Muhammad Ali to win the heavyweight title in just his eighth pro fight

rows.label: Riddick Bowe
rows.hook: beat Evander Holyfield and is remembered for a fight halted by a parachutist crashing into the ring

rows.label: Andre Ward
rows.hook: won Olympic gold and retired unbeaten as a super middleweight champion

rows.label: Floyd Patterson
rows.hook: was the youngest heavyweight champion of his time and the first to regain the title after losing it

rows.label: Frank Bruno
rows.hook: was a hugely popular heavyweight who finally won a world title and became a pantomime star

rows.label: Ken Norton
rows.hook: famously broke the jaw of Muhammad Ali in a fight and later became a heavyweight champion

rows.label: David Haye
rows.hook: was a cruiserweight champion who moved up to fight a giant heavyweight champion, Valuev

rows.label: Nick Diaz
rows.hook: is a UFC welterweight famous for pressure boxing, triathlon training and a brother who also fights

rows.label: Nikolai Valuev
rows.description: Russian politician and former heavyweight boxer
rows.hook: was a heavyweight champion standing over seven feet tall, nicknamed The Beast from the East

rows.label: Holly Holm
rows.description: American boxer and mixed martial artist (born 1981)
rows.hook: scored a stunning head-kick knockout of Ronda Rousey to win the UFC bantamweight title

rows.label: Buakaw Banchamek
rows.hook: is a Muay Thai superstar who won tournaments in K-1 and acted in action films
